feedback.intro: Thanks for testing BitTasker. Share your feedback with us!
feedback.type_label: Is this a bug, or a feature request? *
feedback.type_help_text: A bug is a feature that's present that isn't working as it should be. A feature request is for adding new abilities to the app that aren't currently present.
feedback.describe_placeholder: Please provide a detailed description of the bug or feature request...
feedback.screenshot_hint: If possible, please include a screenshot that illustrates the issue you're seeing.
feedback.contact_hint: Please enter your email address, Telegram username, or WhatsApp number in case we have follow up questions.
feedback.thank_you_message: Your feedback has been submitted successfully. We appreciate you taking the time to help us improve BitTasker!

errors.select_type: Please select Bug or Feature Request
errors.missing_user: Unable to identify user. Please try again.
errors.submit_failed: Failed to submit feedback. Please try again.
